title: Alto Vista Chapel
scope: The standing Alto Vista Chapel on the coastal rise in Noord, Aruba, with the yellow nave, tiled roof, small pointed steeple and stone entry platform.
limitations: Focused on the standing exterior, its orange-red roof and limestone platform. The rear gable, smaller trim and window glazing are approximate.
The extended courtyard, cacti, low freestanding benches and interior furnishings are outside model scope.
